name: Setting Sun
source:
Sunchowi is known as a seaport city.

With its beautiful scenery and transportation, it was a city that everyone wanted, but the forces in the shadows continued to grow. After a crackdown on drug lords and criminal operations, Sunchowi suffered from government business sanctions, a major blow to the steel and transportation industries, and a sharp decline in population.

It was a once prosperous city, made insular by his pride and greed, and Sunchowi saw its sunset, leaving behind only a drained land and a weary people.

You

An uninitiated college student will witness the history of the city's decline...

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240228083217/https://bigshu.itch.io/setting-sun]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Sunchowi以港口城市闻名。

凭借秀丽的风景和便利的交通，这里曾是人人向往的城市，但暗处的势力却不断壮大。在打击毒枭和犯罪活动后，Sunchowi遭到政府的商业制裁，钢铁与交通运输行业受到重创，人口也急剧减少。

这座曾经繁荣的城市因自身的骄傲与贪婪而变得封闭，最终迎来了日落，只留下资源枯竭的土地和疲惫不堪的人们。

你

一名毫无经验的大学生，将亲眼见证这座城市衰败的历史……
